snippet_primary: "I was trying to purchase something on Gumroad for $0, but as I got to the checkout, it said that I have an active chargeback on one of my past Gumroad purchases. However, I wasn't logged in, I didn't give them my card information AND I HAVEN'T USED GUMROAD BEFORE. So, even if I did have an active chargeback, how would they know?"
subject_exact: Trustpilot review of Gumroad (August 12, 2025) reports a checkout block message claiming an active chargeback on past purchases for a user who was not logged in, had not provided card information, and had never used Gumroad before
local_qualifiers: Trustpilot review (Aug 12, 2025): Gumroad blocked $0 checkout citing 'active chargeback on past purchases' for a user with no account, no card data, and no prior Gumroad use
parser_notes: trustpilot.com/review/gumroad.com?page=3 (Aug 12, 2025). English. Gumroad fraud detection: false positive chargeback flag for first-time user with no login or card data. Documents potential fingerprinting-based block affecting users with no purchase history.
